text_block_list.text:
Sakura Bakushin O, having triumphed in a 
nail-biting showdown against Nishino 
Flower.

However, the Trainer stoked Sakura 
Bakushin O's fire, asking if she didn't 
want to win by an overwhelming margin 
against a formidable opponent like Nishino 
Flower.

Deeply moved by the Trainer's words, she 
set her sights on the Takamatsunomiya 
Kinen to face Nishino Flower once more.
